description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty Internal Plugin for compiling the {eval} tag, defining the class Smarty_Internal_Compile_Eval which handles compile-time code generation for the {eval} Smarty template tag.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Eval
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {eval} tag in Smarty templates, generating PHP code to evaluate inline template code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to evaluate an eval block in a Smarty template, optionally assigning the output to a variable.
